``` {r OverallChangeNovice, echo = FALSE}
## IMPLICIT ATTITUDES --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Combine all data
race.WtsnovelALL <- ts(c(race.Wtsnovel, race.WtsnovelNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.WtsnovelALL <- ts(c(age.Wtsnovel, age.WtsnovelNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
dis.WtsnovelALL <- ts(c(dis.Wtsnovel, dis.WtsnovelNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
skin.WtsnovelALL <- ts(c(skin.Wtsnovel, skin.WtsnovelNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WtsnovelALL <- ts(c(sex.Wtsnovel, sex.WtsnovelNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
weight.WtsnovelALL <- ts(c(weightBody.Wtsnovel, weight.WtsnovelNEW), start = c(2015, 1), frequency = 12)

## RACE ---------------
# fit model from Charlesworth & Banaji (2019, Psych Science).
race.arimanovel <- auto.arima(race.Wtsnovel, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.racenovel <- forecast(race.arimanovel, h = 48)
decomp.racenovel <- decompose(race.Wtsnovel)
race.acc.MASE <- accuracy(forecast.racenovel, race.WtsnovelNEW)["Test set","MASE"]
race.acc.MAPE <- accuracy(forecast.racenovel, race.WtsnovelNEW)["Test set","MAPE"]
race.acc.MAE <- accuracy(forecast.racenovel, race.WtsnovelNEW)["Test set","MAE"]
race.acc.RMSE <- accuracy(forecast.racenovel, race.WtsnovelNEW)["Test set","RMSE"]

# fit model to novelALL data (combined)
race.arimanovelALL <- auto.arima(race.WtsnovelALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.racenovelALL <- forecast(race.arimanovelALL, h = 60)
forecast.racenovelLONGALL <- forecast(race.arimanovelALL, h = 2400) 
minbound.racenovelALL <- min(which(forecast.racenovelLONGALL$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12 
meanbound.racenovelALL <- min(which(forecast.racenovelLONGALL$mean<=0))/12 
maxbound.racenovelALL <- min(which(forecast.racenovelLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WtsnovelALL[1]))/12 
decomp.racenovelALL <- decompose(race.WtsnovelALL)
start.racenovelALL <- decompose(race.WtsnovelALL)$trend[7]
end.racenovelALL <- decompose(race.WtsnovelALL)$trend[162]
pch.racenovelALL <- (decomp.racenovelALL$trend[7] - decomp.racenovelALL$trend[162])/decomp.racenovelALL$trend[7] 
rch.racenovelALL <- decomp.racenovelALL$trend[7] - decomp.racenovelALL$trend[162] 

# fit model to novelNEW data (only recent)
race.arimanovelNEW <- auto.arima(race.WtsnovelNEW, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.racenovelNEW <- forecast(race.arimanovelNEW, h = 60)
forecast.racenovelLONGNEW <- forecast(race.arimanovelNEW, h = 2400) 
minbound.racenovelNEW <- min(which(forecast.racenovelLONGNEW$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12 
meanbound.racenovelNEW <- min(which(forecast.racenovelLONGNEW$mean<=0))/12 
maxbound.racenovelNEW <- min(which(forecast.racenovelLONGNEW$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WtsnovelNEW[1]))/12 
decomp.racenovelNEW <- decompose(race.WtsnovelNEW)
start.racenovelNEW <- decompose(race.WtsnovelNEW)$trend[7]
end.racenovelNEW <- decompose(race.WtsnovelNEW)$trend[42]

new.change.table_novel$meanfor <- round(c(meanbound.agenovelNEW, meanbound.disnovelNEW, meanbound.skinnovelNEW, 
                                 meanbound.racenovelNEW, meanbound.sexnovelNEW, meanbound.weightnovelNEW,
                                 meanbound.E.agenovelNEW, meanbound.E.disnovelNEW, meanbound.E.skinnovelNEW, 
                                 meanbound.E.racenovelNEW, meanbound.E.sexnovelNEW, meanbound.E.weightnovelNEW), 2) 

for (i in 1:nrow(new.change.table_novel)){
  new.change.table_novel$meanfor[i] <- ifelse(grepl("Inf", new.change.table_novel$meanfor[i]), ">200 yrs", new.change.table_novel$meanfor[i])
}

new.change.table_novel$maxfor <- round(c(maxbound.agenovelNEW, maxbound.disnovelNEW, maxbound.skinnovelNEW, 
                                 maxbound.racenovelNEW, maxbound.sexnovelNEW, maxbound.weightnovelNEW,
                                 maxbound.E.agenovelNEW, maxbound.E.disnovelNEW, maxbound.E.skinnovelNEW, 
                                 maxbound.E.racenovelNEW, maxbound.E.sexnovelNEW, maxbound.E.weightnovelNEW), 2) 

for (i in 1:nrow(new.change.table_novel)){
  new.change.table_novel$maxfor[i] <- ifelse(grepl("Inf", new.change.table_novel$maxfor[i]), ">200 yrs", new.change.table_novel$maxfor[i])
}

```
